output.risk_rationale: High provisional onboarding risk as of 2026-10-21, not a finding that Revolut Ltd is criminal or sanctioned. The registered operating entity and corporate control chain are identifiable, but reported AML/sanctions-control concerns, fraud-protection complaints and entity-specific litigation warrant enhanced due diligence. Civil proceedings cited are interlocutory and allegations are distinguished from findings. Most importantly, OFAC, UK and EU screening remains unverified, so this is not sanctions clearance; the controller’s reported close-family link also needs current PEP/RCA review. Companies House shows a confirmation-statement-overdue warning. The Lithuanian bank’s AML fine, the separate UK bank’s licensing issue and an unrelated FCA-warning namesake are excluded rather than attributed to this company. Resolve sanctions screening, complete current officer/beneficial-owner verification and obtain case updates before approval.
